attempts.summary: Deployed a WireGuard-gated service topology: node2 serves an HTTP app on TCP 8080, node1 (VyOS) terminates a WireGuard tunnel (wg0, 10.200.0.0/24) with node3 as the sole peer, and node2's iptables INPUT chain drops all TCP/8080 traffic except from the WireGuard subnet 10.200.0.0/24 (loopback explicitly excepted). node3 reaches node2:8080 only via the tunnel; a direct-LAN bypass attempt from node3 times out. Persistence (systemd units, netplan/systemd-networkd static route, iptables rules.v4 + restore service, WireGuard configs) was verified to survive a real reboot on all three nodes, performed sequentially with boot-id proof and post-restart functional verification.
